description: Turn one sentence about what an agent should do ("Earn funding on NVDA without betting on its price", "Lend my idle USDG on Morpho", with an amount if you like) into the same first plan the AINDEX front page shows: what it would hold and where, how it decides, how free it is, its daily loss limit, and what it can never do. Plus the link that starts it on the website. A keyword sketch, not the agent: the agent writes its real plan once started.

text.description: What the agent should do, in the person's own words.

name: plan_agent
title: A first plan for an agent, from one sentence
